recent: 公司于2026年11月24日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，上半年净利减半至440万令吉，营收下滑21.9%，未派息。此前于2026年9月29日召开第一届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括批准每股0.5仙的终期单层股息。此外，公司近期有多项关于董事在闭锁期交易意向及股权变动的公告，并涉及重大诉讼。
notable: 2026年9月29日召开第一届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括批准每股0.5仙的终期单层股息。

risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，相关公告于2026年9月1日、9月23日及10月8日发布。

earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，公司营收为4097.4万令吉，环比增长93.5%，但同比下降35.0%；净利为52.1万令吉，同比下降90.4%，净利率为1.3%，较上一季度的-66.1%转正。

recent_en: The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 24 November 2026, with H1 net profit halving to RM4.4 million as revenue fell 21.9%, and no dividend declared. Its First Annual General Meeting was held on 29 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including approval of a final single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share. There were also announcements on directors' intentions to deal during the closed period and changes in shareholdings, as well as material litigation.
notable_en: The First Annual General Meeting was held on 29 September 2026, and all resolutions were passed, including approval of a final single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share.
Quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 were announced on 24 November 2026, with H1 net profit halving to RM4.4 million as revenue fell 21.9%, and no dividend declared.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, with announcements on 1 September, 23 September, and 8 October 2026.
Several directors have expressed intentions to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM40.974 million, up 93.5% QoQ but down 35.0% YoY; net income was RM0.521 million, down 90.4% YoY, with a net margin of 1.3% compared to -66.1% in the previous quarter.
